subject: Missed walkthrough — timezone-friendly options & async fallback
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Quick follow-up — missed walkthrough and easy next steps

Hi Sylvia —

Sorry we missed you for the scheduled walkthrough earlier. I know schedules get tight — happy to be flexible. Two quick options so we can keep momentum: 

1) Micro-slot reschedule (15 minutes): I can offer a few compact slots that span timezones (AM/PM windows). If you share 2–3 preferred times I’ll lock one in.

2) Async walkthrough: I can send a short recorded demo tailored to the areas you flagged (ingestion, latency, and cost controls) plus a 5-slide mutual action plan. You can watch on your cadence and I’ll follow up with a short live Q&A if helpful.

If you want the live route, here’s a quick scheduler link: https://calendly.com/redwood/sdrcatchup

Attached is a 1-page MVP demo agenda to help decide (MVP-demo-agenda.pdf).

Would you prefer a 15-min micro-slot or the async walkthrough + 10-min sync?

Thanks,
Evelyn

Evelyn Hart
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference — Inference for production

Attachment: MVP-demo-agenda.pdf (pdf)

From: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jan 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — missed walkthrough and easy next steps

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for following up — apologies, the team got pulled into an urgent incident this morning. We are interested and I think the async walkthrough + short sync will work best for us.

Would you be able to: 
- Send the recorded demo focused on data ingestion and latency profiles.
- Include an estimated TCO illustration for a 3-month pilot.

If a follow-up sync is needed, I can pull in David Park (our Cloud Platform lead) — he’s at david.park@arcadiahealth.com and can do afternoons PT next week (Tue/Wed after 1pm PT).

Thanks — Sylvia

Sylvia Kim
Director of Data Platforms, Arcadia Health
sylvia.kim@arcadiahealth.com | +1 (206) 555-0221

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jan 2028 13:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — missed walkthrough and easy next steps

Hi Sylvia — great, thanks for the clarity. Plan below: 

- I’ll send a 9-minute recorded walkthrough that covers ingestion, latency tuning, and the most common pilot configs.
- Priyom will attach a concise TCO snapshot for a 3-month pilot (tokens + dedicated capacity delta).
- I’ll also include a one-sheet mutual action plan so stakeholders have next steps.

Deliverables (by end of day):
- Recorded walkthrough link: https://drive.google.com/recorded-walkthrough-arcadia (will be in the email I send)
- Mutual action plan: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (attachment)
- TCO snapshot (inline in the email and attached as a short table)

If you want to convert to a live sync after watching, I can propose 30-min windows on Tue/Wed next week after 1pm PT — I’ll draft three options and send a calendar invite that includes David.

Quick confirmation request: do you want the invite to be 15 or 30 minutes? I recommend 30 if David will join.

Best,
Evelyn

Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Park <david.park@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jan 2028 14:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — missed walkthrough and easy next steps

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks — we watched the recording and it was very helpful. Let’s do a 30-minute live sync on Wednesday 31 Jan at 1:30pm PT; I added David on this reply so he has context.

Also, David sent over a short procurement note (SOW-prep-note.docx) asking for two things to prep the SOW: anticipated data retention options and whether audit logs can be exported to their GCS. If you can have a short answer ready in the sync, that would be great.

Looking forward to it.

— Sylvia

Attachment: SOW-prep-note.docx (docx)
